input: raw XYZ; learned pillar features, no hand-rendered BEV images
optimizer: AdamW lr .001, weight decay .0001, cosine decay to .00001, gradient clip 10
mixed_precision: bfloat16 autocast, float32 parameters and losses
selection: Every 5 epochs: maximize validation 3D AP50, then AP25, then minimize supervised loss. Test all four runs only after training finishes.
test_scope: Existing retrospective grouped fold 3; all test data already diagnosed previously. Not fresh blind evaluation.
metric: 101 recall-level interpolated AP, exact convex cuboid intersection including source roll/pitch. Experimental evaluator, not official OSDaR23 benchmark.
architecture_limit: Small custom PointPillars-style CNN and local-window-attention hybrid, not official pretrained model implementations.
